1. Obtain this higher-level SAGE report for each assigned job.
2. Compare labor hours and spending with the approved job Cost Detail spreadsheet.
3. Investigate flagged concerns using the separate, more detailed SAGE report.
4. Escalate confirmed budget concerns to the general manager.
